description: Reviewed Gymnasium G8/G9 duration-model decisions for the nationwide SkillPilot Physics goal atlas. SekI+SekII is an atlas projection decision; an upper-secondary source extraction does not by itself establish Sek-I placement.

decisions.subject: Physik
decisions.rationale: Atlas projection decision reviewed on 2026-08-20: Brandenburg Gymnasium starts after the regular six-year primary school and runs through Jahrgangsstufe 12, so SkillPilot binds the state to the G8 duration label. The retained official Physics extraction itself covers Sek II only; it does not establish Sek-I placements, and the nationwide Physics atlas therefore uses one duration-neutral CrossStage view without inventing a separate G9 projection.
